mathematical_semantics: Contradict_l(Ci,Cj) = Overlap(Ci,Cj) AND Align_l(Ci,Cj) AND NOT Compat_l(Ci,Cj); alignment failure yields NOT_COMPARABLE_UNDER_REGISTERED_MAP, never a contradiction
severity ladder RAW_CONFLICT superset ALIGNED_CONTRADICTION superset DECISIVE_REFUTATION, each level adding a discharged obligation (alignment map; sufficient authority for the target regime)

transition_semantics: deterministic in (claim pair, registered transition maps, authority state); set-valued only when multiple registered maps disagree, which itself emits a MAP_AMBIGUITY residual
a DECISIVE_REFUTATION downgraded by certificate revocation reverts to ALIGNED_CONTRADICTION and never silently disappears
